turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why was Owen's zero entered before anyone called me?
Before we start, I reread Owen's last three essays this morning.
Okay. Did you answer my question, or was that something else?
He writes like someone who was read to every night. That was you, wasn't it?
That's my son's childhood, and it's not a document. Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
You've raised a genuinely thoughtful kid. I mean that.
Flattery isn't an answer. Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
Which is why I'd hate for this to become a fight between two people who obviously both care about him.
I'm not here to be on a team. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
